title: AI's Honesty Crisis: A Teacher's Perspective #shorts
description: A teacher with 24 years of experience discusses the honesty crisis exacerbated by AI. The internet's arrival marked the first major honesty crisis, making dishonesty easier to commit and harder to detect. #HonestyCrisis #AI #Education #Cheating #TeacherTalk
